```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

```{r main}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(here)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(margins) 


df_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "model_data_imputed.csv"))

df <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "model_data_imputed.csv")) |>
  mutate(
    is_weekend     = as.integer(day_type == "Weekend"),
    speed_limit_sq = speed_limit^2,
    high_speed_50  = as.integer(speed_limit >= 50),
    high_speed_60  = as.integer(speed_limit >= 60),
    night_x_rural  = is_night * rural
  )

cat("N після очищення:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Частка severe:", round(mean(df$severe) * 100, 1), "%\n")

controls_model <- readRDS(here("regression", "outputs", "models", "controls_model.rds"))


severity_by_hour <- df |>
  group_by(hour) |>
  summarise(pct_severe = mean(severe), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(severity_by_hour, aes(x = hour, y = pct_severe)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkred") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:23) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Частка тяжких ДТП по годинах доби",
    subtitle = "LOESS (червона) vs лінійна (оранжева) — U-подібна нелінійність",
    x = "Година доби", y = "Частка severe", size = "К-ть ДТП"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

severity_by_speed <- df |>
  group_by(speed_limit) |>
  summarise(pct_severe = mean(severe), n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(severity_by_speed, aes(x = speed_limit, y = pct_severe)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.7, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "darkred") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "orange", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Частка тяжких ДТП за обмеженням швидкості",
    subtitle = "LOESS явно нелінійний → виправдовує speed² у моделях M5/M6",
    x = "Speed limit (mph)", y = "Частка severe", size = "К-ть ДТП"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


speed_squared_model <- glm(
  severe ~ is_night + rural + speed_limit + speed_limit_sq +
    light_conditions + weather_conditions +
    road_surface_conditions + road_type + day_type,
  data = df, family = binomial("logit")
)

high_speed_model <- glm(
  severe ~ is_night + rural + speed_limit + high_speed_60 +
    light_conditions + weather_conditions +
    road_surface_conditions + road_type + day_type,
  data = df, family = binomial("logit")
)

interaction_model <- glm(
  severe ~ is_night * rural + speed_limit +
    light_conditions + weather_conditions +
    road_surface_conditions + road_type + day_type,
  data = df, family = binomial("logit")
)

cat("Всі три моделі оцінено.\n")


hc_se <- function(model) coeftest(model, vcov = vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))

cat("\n=== speed_squared_model ===\n"); print(hc_se(speed_squared_model))
cat("\n=== high_speed_model ===\n");    print(hc_se(high_speed_model))
cat("\n=== interaction_model ===\n");   print(hc_se(interaction_model))


cat("\n=== Joint test: speed_limit + speed_limit_sq = 0 ===\n")
jt_speed_sq <- linearHypothesis(
  speed_squared_model,
  c("speed_limit = 0", "speed_limit_sq = 0"),
  vcov = vcovHC(speed_squared_model, type = "HC1")
)
print(jt_speed_sq)

cat("\n=== Joint test: speed_limit_sq = 0 (нелінійність) ===\n")
jt_speed_sq_only <- linearHypothesis(
  speed_squared_model,
  "speed_limit_sq = 0",
  vcov = vcovHC(speed_squared_model, type = "HC1")
)
print(jt_speed_sq_only)

cat("\n=== Joint test: is_night + is_night:rural = 0 ===\n")
jt_night <- linearHypothesis(
  interaction_model,
  c("is_night = 0", "is_night:rural = 0"),
  vcov = vcovHC(interaction_model, type = "HC1")
)
print(jt_night)
ame_speed_sq   <- margins(speed_squared_model, vcov = vcovHC(speed_squared_model, "HC1"))
ame_high_speed <- margins(high_speed_model,    vcov = vcovHC(high_speed_model,    "HC1"))
ame_interact   <- margins(interaction_model,   vcov = vcovHC(interaction_model,   "HC1"))

cat("\n=== AME: speed_squared_model ===\n"); print(summary(ame_speed_sq))
cat("\n=== AME: high_speed_model ===\n");    print(summary(ame_high_speed))
cat("\n=== AME: interaction_model ===\n");   print(summary(ame_interact))

ame_df <- summary(ame_interact) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(factor_label = dplyr::recode(factor,
    "is_night"      = "Ніч (00–04)",
    "is_weekend"    = "Вихідний день",
    "rural"         = "Сільська місцевість",
    "speed_limit"   = "Speed limit"
  ))

ggplot(ame_df, aes(x = reorder(factor_label, AME), y = AME)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower, ymax = upper), width = 0.2, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Маржинальні ефекти (AME) — interaction_model",
    subtitle = "Середній вплив кожного фактора на P(severe ДТП)",
    x = NULL, y = "AME (у відсоткових пунктах)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)


extract_key_coefs <- function(model, model_name, key_terms) {
  ct_mat <- coeftest(model, vcov = vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))

  ct_df <- tibble(
    term      = rownames(ct_mat),
    estimate  = ct_mat[, 1],
    std_error = ct_mat[, 2],
    z_value   = ct_mat[, 3],
    p_value   = ct_mat[, 4]
  )

  ct_df |>
    filter(term %in% key_terms) |>
    transmute(
      model         = model_name,
      term          = term,
      estimate      = round(estimate, 4),
      std_error_hc1 = round(std_error, 4),
      z_value       = round(z_value, 3),
      p_value       = round(p_value, 4),
      significant   = case_when(
        p_value < 0.01 ~ "***",
        p_value < 0.05 ~ "**",
        p_value < 0.1  ~ "*",
        TRUE           ~ ""
      )
    )
}

key_terms <- c("is_night", "rural", "speed_limit_sq",
               "high_speed_60", "is_night:rural")

robustness_coefs <- bind_rows(
  extract_key_coefs(speed_squared_model, "speed_squared_model", key_terms),
  extract_key_coefs(high_speed_model,    "high_speed_model",    key_terms),
  extract_key_coefs(interaction_model,   "interaction_model",   key_terms)
)

write_csv(robustness_coefs,
          here("regression", "outputs", "tables", "robustness_key_coefficients.csv"))
cat("\nЗбережено: robustness_key_coefficients.csv\n")
print(robustness_coefs)


extract_jt <- function(jt_result, hypothesis_label, model_name) {
  tibble(
    model       = model_name,
    hypothesis  = hypothesis_label,
    df          = jt_result$Df[2],
    chisq       = round(jt_result$Chisq[2], 3),
    p_value     = round(jt_result$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], 5),
    significant = case_when(
      jt_result$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.01 ~ "***",
      jt_result$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.05 ~ "**",
      jt_result$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2] < 0.1  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )
}

joint_tests_robustness <- bind_rows(
  extract_jt(jt_speed_sq,      "speed_limit + speed_limit_sq = 0", "speed_squared_model"),
  extract_jt(jt_speed_sq_only, "speed_limit_sq = 0",               "speed_squared_model"),
  extract_jt(jt_night,         "is_night + is_night:rural = 0",    "interaction_model")
)

write_csv(joint_tests_robustness,
          here("regression", "outputs", "tables", "joint_tests_robustness.csv"))
cat("\nЗбережено: joint_tests_robustness.csv\n")
print(joint_tests_robustness)


saveRDS(speed_squared_model,
        here("regression", "outputs", "models", "speed_squared_model.rds"))
saveRDS(high_speed_model,
        here("regression", "outputs", "models", "high_speed_model.rds"))
saveRDS(interaction_model,
        here("regression", "outputs", "models", "interaction_model.rds"))

cat("\nЗбережено: speed_squared_model.rds\n")
cat("Збережено: high_speed_model.rds\n")
cat("Збережено: interaction_model.rds\n")

```
